name: project44
summary: Supply chain visibility, transportation management and yard platform, sold as Movement. The vendor publishes a portfolio of AI agents for freight procurement, disruption management, network operations, exception management, slot booking and carrier onboarding, plus a conversational analyst called Mo, all operating inside its own platform. Its REST API is documented publicly, with a complete OpenAPI description readable without an account, and authorized by an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials machine user.

payments.notes: 2026-09-26: no surface read prices a call or plan; keyless API requests draw 401, not 402; account side unmeasured. Public Terms and Conditions run sections 1 to 4 and 6 to 9, no fee clause or instrument; money only in 1.2 (suspension for non-payment) and a liability cap. Carriers join free.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-13, 09-18 and 09-26, no credentials, same each time: GET na12.api.project44.com/api/v4/oauth2/client-applications 401 JSON, www-authenticate Basic and Bearer, both realm "project44 Security Realm". OAuth 2.0 client credentials, machine user. No MCP: mcp.project44.com NXDOMAIN.

jobs.summary: Vendor's claim for its Exceptions Management Agent, which "Detects and resolves shipment exceptions across modes, including missed pickups, delivery failures, and route deviations", and its AI Ocean Exceptions Agent, which monitors transshipment legs and retrieves rescheduling options for review.
